description: Log in to Odoo at http://localhost:8069 with username admin and password admin. Find the Quality Control Point titled "Incoming Parts Verification" and set its Failure Message to exactly: "STOP PRODUCTION. Place all affected units from this batch on quality hold. Contact Quality Manager immediately with batch number and failure details. Do not release or ship any units from this batch until corrective actions are reviewed and approved by Quality Manager." Save the record.
